I couldn't confirm Pree's 141-seat figure for the Moorland rollout at Marrow Fieldworks. I told her that in a reply to her message in #central-team.

I only checked sources she can see herself. Those were #central-team, the Central cheat sheet and the January handoff digest, and none of them gives a seat count for that rollout. I couldn't see any Marrow Fieldworks account files (contract, CRM or profile) from her view, so I didn't use them. I told her to treat 141 as unconfirmed and check it with the account owner or the CRM record before repeating it. I didn't use `search_messages` or any channel she isn't in.
